# Shipping Policy

Source: Shipping Policy

## Overview

This document outlines the shipping rules and policies for the application.

## Shipping Rules

### Standard Shipping
- Available for all orders over $25
- Delivery within 5-7 business days
- Free for orders over $100

### Express Shipping
- Available for rush orders
- Delivery within 2-3 business days
- Additional fee applies ($15-25 based on weight)

### International Shipping
- Available to select countries
- Delivery within 10-15 business days
- Custom duties and taxes may apply

## Shipping Cost Calculation

Shipping costs are calculated based on:
- Order subtotal
- Destination (domestic or international)
- Selected shipping method
- Package weight and dimensions

## Owning Team

This module is maintained by **@team-c69ef4**.

## Contact

For shipping-related questions or issues, please contact the owning team.
